correctness.rationale: A fully specified symmetric weighted Laplacian has eigenvalues 0, 2d, n, h and yields two explicit exact voltage transfer formulas. The proof exhausts every matching and nonmatching column entry sign and multiplicity, retaining the only variable-sign reverse edge as an absolute value. Bounding the nonmatching columns and diagonal terms leaves one uniformly convergent scaling function with unique cubic stationary maximizer; both projection suprema have the same limit because diagonal complements change every column sum by at most one. The embedded independent exact-rational grounded-Laplacian checker replays 516 columns in 24 graphs.

value.rationale: Conductance-tuning a perfect matching inside a natural dense graph generates sharp √n growth of two canonical Banach-space endpoint norms, although their uniform-conductance norms remain bounded. The exact entire-parameter formulas distinguish the two source-edge types and a sign transition, and the cubic maximizer supplies a sharp universal scaling invariant; these structural conclusions go beyond a sample computation or a textbook normalization.
